chapter: The Paradise and life in Queens
title: Paying sidemen fifteen dollars and the Tennessee Waltz tip
summary: He paid sidemen about fifteen dollars a night, and a woman once tipped twenty dollars for Tennessee Waltz.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Oh, payment was low, oh my God, I think I was payin' the guys like 15 dollars a night.
And you had a regular salary?
And then did you get tips on top of that, was that a regular part of it?
Well once in a while we'd get tips. I'll never forget we did, when John Acee

was playin' piano, somebody--some woman--wanted "Tennessee Waltz" and she had 20 dollars. I says, "Look here man," I says, "You all want to play 'Tennessee Waltz'? Here's 20 dollars." They say, "Yeah, just start the lead and we got you." (laughter) The "Tennessee Waltz", I'll be dawgone. I just happened to know that song. Get that 20 dollars. (laughter)
